greeting: Chronos on comms. Stage 6: All Roads Lead. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Against Time. Objective drift gets teams buried.
The walls keep whispering patch notes. I only trust the ones with timestamps.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Rally all zone allies.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Rally all zone allies; Consolidate the alliance forces; March on the Capital. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Gather allies and prepare for the assault on the Capital. Immediate move: Rally all zone allies.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 6 resolved: All Roads Lead. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Epilogue Transition.
rumor: Citizens keep meeting tomorrow versions of themselves and borrowing bad advice.
People keep repeating one clue from All Roads Lead: 'March on the Capital'.
I put fear on a schedule. It keeps missing meetings.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn loops are usually stable. Mark your path or the street will rearrange you.
dialog.time_noon: Noon produces the most timeline echoes. Do not chase every duplicate signal.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk is paradox weather. If a clock runs backward, leave it alone.
dialog.time_night: Night splits voices from bodies. Use call-and-response to track your team.

party_reactions.kade: Chronos sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Chronos accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Chronos talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Identify your lane and your fallback.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Good timing. We can still salvage this window.
relationship_dialog.friend: You know the drill. I trust your judgment.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: If the world bends, we bend it back together.
